description.value: Sula is an award-winning Indian restaurant established in 2010 on Commercial Drive, named best Indian restaurant in Vancouver by both Vancouver Magazine and Georgia Straight in 2025. The menu spans traditional Indian dishes, tandoor cooking, street food, and signature craft cocktails, with three Vancouver locations. Touring cyclists can dine in or order takeout from the original Commercial Drive location on one of the city's most vibrant cycling corridors.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 80m; rack at 94m; rack at 96m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms SULA Indian Restaurant at Commercial Drive, Vancouver is an active, award-winning multi-location Indian restaurant established in 2010, with a 2026 copyright footer and current awards cited. The site has a dedicated 'Takeout and Delivery' section with an 'ORDER ONLINE' call-to-action confirming takeout service. The website FAQ explicitly states all locations offer a dedicated vegetarian and vegan section with plant-based starters and dairy-free curries; no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
